thread:
julia (AP): Received INV-721004 for $9,750 from Vendor-Intl; invoice includes $250 late fee but PO field is blank. Auto-match failed. Need advice on whether to net the late fee off the invoice or request reissue.
approvals-bot: Invoice 721004 queued. Match failed: missing PO.
vendor-intl-billing: Hi Julia, sorry about that. The late fee was auto-added by our billing system. The underlying invoice relates to PO-2026-99 but the export omitted it. We can reissue within 2 business days or confirm in writing to allow immediate application.
kevin (Procurement): @julia please attach invoice snippet. Policy: credits/adjustments need PO reference or procurement exception. For <$10k we can escalate to Director.
julia (AP): snippet:
```
Invoice: INV-721004
Amount: 9,750.00 USD
Line: Services 9,500.00
Late fee: 250.00
PO: -- (blank)
Notes: billed after 30-day term
```
maria (Finance): If vendor confirms PO-2026-99 in writing and accepts netting the late fee, we can apply without waiting for reissue. GL: 6102-Cloud-SaaS. But director sign-off required for missing PO.
vendor-intl-billing: Written confirmation: "Vendor-Intl confirms INV-721004 applies to PO-2026-99. The $250 late fee was incorrectly charged and Vendor-Intl agrees to waive it; please apply a credit of $250 against INV-721004."
kevin (Procurement): I'll create procurement exception EXC-12001: "missing PO on invoice < 10k + vendor waiver of late fee" and route to Maria (Finance Director).
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-12001 created, routed to Maria (Finance Dir) for approval.
maria (Finance): Reviewed. Vendor confirmation attached; waiver documented. Approving EXC-12001. AP, apply credit of $250 to INV-721004, post to GL 6102-Cloud-SaaS, and note exception reference in reconciliation.
julia (AP): Applied $250 credit, invoice netted to $9,500. Ledger updated and reconciliation uploaded to EXC-12001. Noted PO-2026-99 in the ticket.
kevin (Procurement): Procurement will request reissued invoice with PO-2026-99 for records but EXC-12001 will close once reissue received.
vendor-intl-billing: Thank you. We'll reissue and upload PO'd invoice. Apologies for the trouble.
sam (CFO): Quick note: thanks for documenting exception. Keep these exceptions <10k consistent with policy; escalate if frequency increases.
julia (AP): Will track frequency and report in monthly vendor exceptions dashboard. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
